subject.title: [Feature]: Add metadata-only message lifecycle events to audit history

question: Should OpenClaw's durable audit history expand to opt-in message lifecycle records, and is `audit.messages: off | direct | all` the intended long-term privacy and scope contract?
rationale: This changes a newly accepted core audit product's storage, privacy, access, protocol, retention, and configuration boundary; source evidence proves feasibility but cannot determine maintainer intent.

options.title: Approve scoped message audit
options.body: Add metadata-only events with `audit.messages` defaulting to `off`, explicit direct/all scope, and complete shared-path coverage proof.

options.title: Keep run/tool-only audit
options.body: Keep the durable ledger limited to agent runs and tools and use diagnostics or hooks for message lifecycle investigations.

options.title: Start direct-only
options.body: Persist lifecycle metadata only for direct conversations and defer group/channel records.

recommendation.title: Approve scoped message audit
recommendation.body: Add metadata-only events with `audit.messages` defaulting to `off`, explicit direct/all scope, and complete shared-path coverage proof.

likelyOwner.reason: The current audit product decision and proposed expansion both trace directly to this person's merged feature history.
